infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KisanSahay needs microphone access for hands-free voice search across government schemes.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: KisanSahay uses speech recognition to understand Indian regional languages and voice commands.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KisanSahay needs camera access so you can scan and secure your Aadhaar, KCC, and land records into the Document Vault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KisanSahay requires photo library access to attach farm documents and scheme verification proofs.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KisanSahay uses your location to automatically recommend government schemes and show soil health for your state and district.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow KisanSahay to access the microphone for voice queries in Indian languages.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow KisanSahay to securely recognize speech for agricultural schemes.
